description: The key every 'a valid API key is provided' step of the acceptance suite authenticates with. Never expires.
The key every 'an expired API key is provided' step presents: it exists, but its expiry is in the past, so admin requests carrying it are rejected.
A key with an expiry that has not yet passed, so an expiry check comparing against now() is distinguishable from one merely testing that expires_at is null.
